label: v53.64
changes: Rebuilt My Job around one large visual Focus card instead of presenting the full technical stack at once
Added a new dark Pinnacle header with crew identity, live/offline state and drawing-source traceability in one compact bar
Made the current task the visual centre of the page with large title, clear DO THIS and DONE WHEN cards, and a permanent STOP / CONFIRM safety block
Collapsed the old verbose task detail behind SHOW FULL JOB DETAIL so the default screen is substantially simpler without removing source-backed information
Converted Big Jobs into a compact Project Priorities surface showing the top three first
Expanded the desktop workspace to 1200px and introduced a new restrained navy, white, green and gold visual system with stronger spacing and hierarchy
Kept the performance-first runtime event-driven: no MutationObserver, no polling loop, no continuous layout scan
Preserved shared DONE history, assignments, holds, selected crew member and task data; this release changes presentation, not project state
